description: Forecasting Energy Consumption Analysis and Simulation Tool - Residential (FORECAST Residential) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Fraunhofer ISI. Simulation of the long-term final energy consumption of appliances and processes in the residential sector excluding final energy consumption for space heating, space cooling and hot water. Coverage: Germany. Methodical focus: final energy demand. Time resolution: annual. Spatial resolution: households. Software: MS Visual Studio 2017, SQLite, MS Excel, Visua Basic. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
